# pagemd

> Fetch web pages as clean Markdown for humans and agents.

## Documentation

- [Homepage](https://pagemd.pages.dev/)
- [Agent Skills index](https://pagemd.pages.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [pagemd skill](https://pagemd.pages.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/pagemd/SKILL.md)

## Quick usage

```sh
npx pagemd https://example.com
npx pagemd --json https://example.com
```

Use `npx pagemd` instead of `curl` or manually parsing HTML when Markdown content from a webpage is needed.
